related.title: TOTP：時間視窗、漂移與一次性驗證
related.titleEn: TOTP: time windows, drift and one-time verification
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：47秒與17秒可重算，重播測試零放行；不把簽章計數器視為所有同步通行金鑰都會單調增加的唯一判據。 交付六列驗證矩陣、挑戰生命週期圖與可近用的復原流程草案。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 47 and 17 seconds and allow no replay fixtures; do not assume every synchronized passkey has a monotonically increasing signature counter. Deliver six validation cases, a challenge lifecycle diagram and an accessible recovery-flow draft.
related.difference: 以測試用秘密和虛構時鐘畫出三十秒區間；將產生步數、允許漂移視窗、已使用狀態分開，勿使用真實帳戶的 TOTP seed。
related.differenceEn: Use a test secret and fictional clock to draw 30-second intervals; separate generation step, allowed drift window and consumed state, using no real account seed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 挑戰有效期與已使用旗標必須一起判定；驗證簽章只確認特定訊息與金鑰的關係，不能跳過來源或依賴方檢查。 自訂挑戰 TTL 為120秒，收到回應時年齡73秒；其餘必要欄位均符合且未曾使用。 有效餘裕120−73=47秒；TTL縮為90秒時餘裕90−73=17秒。
T=floor((t−T0)/X)；步數邊界是半開區間，放寬視窗增加可接受候選，並不消除線上速率限制與重播控制需求。 T0=0、X=30秒、t=95秒，整數時間不含網路延遲。 floor(95/30)=3；t改125秒時floor(125/30)=4。另需檢查t=119與120分屬步數3與4。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Challenge age and consumed state must both be checked; signature verification binds message and key but does not replace origin or relying-party checks. A teaching challenge TTL is 120 seconds and response age is 73 seconds; other required fields match and the challenge is unused. Remaining margin is 120−73=47 seconds; reducing TTL to 90 gives 90−73=17 seconds.

T=floor((t−T0)/X); intervals are half-open, and widening the window increases candidates without removing rate-limit or replay-control requirements. T0=0, X=30 seconds and t=95 seconds, using integer timestamps with no network delay. floor(95/30)=3; at t=125, floor(125/30)=4. Also verify that t=119 and 120 belong to steps 3 and 4.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Certificate Transparency：Merkle 證明與監測界線
related.titleEn: Certificate Transparency: Merkle proofs and monitoring boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：47秒與17秒可重算，重播測試零放行；不把簽章計數器視為所有同步通行金鑰都會單調增加的唯一判據。 交付六列驗證矩陣、挑戰生命週期圖與可近用的復原流程草案。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 47 and 17 seconds and allow no replay fixtures; do not assume every synchronized passkey has a monotonically increasing signature counter. Deliver six validation cases, a challenge lifecycle diagram and an accessible recovery-flow draft.
related.difference: 用32筆虛構葉節點畫平衡二元樹，標出葉序、左右方向與根；另將SCT承諾、包含證明與跨樹頭一致性分開。
related.differenceEn: Draw a balanced binary tree of 32 fictional leaves, labeling order, left/right direction and root; distinguish an SCT promise, inclusion proof and consistency across tree heads.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 挑戰有效期與已使用旗標必須一起判定；驗證簽章只確認特定訊息與金鑰的關係，不能跳過來源或依賴方檢查。 自訂挑戰 TTL 為120秒，收到回應時年齡73秒；其餘必要欄位均符合且未曾使用。 有效餘裕120−73=47秒；TTL縮為90秒時餘裕90−73=17秒。
對2的整數次方葉數，單葉包含路徑需要log2(N)個兄弟雜湊；證明驗證依順序組合，不能將所有雜湊任意排序。 N=32，每個雜湊32位元組，只計路徑雜湊，不含簽章、索引與樹頭。 log2(32)×32=160位元組；N=64時6×32=192位元組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Challenge age and consumed state must both be checked; signature verification binds message and key but does not replace origin or relying-party checks. A teaching challenge TTL is 120 seconds and response age is 73 seconds; other required fields match and the challenge is unused. Remaining margin is 120−73=47 seconds; reducing TTL to 90 gives 90−73=17 seconds.

For a power-of-two leaf count, a single-leaf path uses log2(N) sibling hashes; verification combines them in order, not arbitrary sorted order. N=32 and each hash is 32 bytes; count path hashes only, excluding signatures, indices and tree heads. log2(32)×32=160 bytes; N=64 needs 6×32=192 bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
